email.subject: Velvet Pros Hair Studio: a couple quick fixes
email.body:
Hi Ravi,

I took a quick look at Velvet Pros Hair Studio's site. Two things are likely costing you bookings: there's no click-to-call, so mobile visitors can't tap to ring you, and there's no online booking, so anyone browsing after hours just leaves instead of reserving a slot. The site also isn't optimized for mobile, images load slowly, and your hours aren't listed anywhere.

I fix sites like this for a flat fee, no ongoing contract. Happy to walk you through what I found in a free 10-minute call, no pressure either way.

Worth a quick chat this week?

Alex
Northlight Web
